content:
The test image clearly shows:
- **White cottony mycelial growth** on the soybean stem
- **Black sclerotia** (hard, dark fungal bodies) embedded in/on the stem tissue
- Stem browning and necrosis

This matches perfectly with White Mold (caused by *Sclerotinia sclerotiorum*). The reference collage confirms the same diagnostic features — white fluffy mycelium on stems with dark sclerotia, identical to the test image.
